About.title: Dr. Nurhan İnan, DDS
About.text: Dr. Nurhan İnan graduated from Istanbul University's Çapa Faculty of Dentistry in 2007 and completed her specialization at the same faculty in 2016. She built her expertise in restorative dentistry at Acıbadem Maslak Hospital and her private clinic in Nişantaşı, and today combines her academic career with clinical practice.
About.internationalLine: International patient experience: care in multiple languages
About.focusText: Her work focuses particularly on smile design and porcelain veneer restorations, following an approach aimed at natural-looking, long-lasting results.
About.philosophyText: Working with a philosophy of minimal intervention for maximum effect, she is committed to preserving as much of the tooth's natural structure as possible while delivering the most aesthetic, durable result for every patient.

Kvkk.title: Privacy Notice (KVKK)
Kvkk.disclaimer: This text is a draft. Legal review is required before publishing.
body: In accordance with Turkey's Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 ("KVKK"), Dr. Nurhan İnan Dental Clinic ("Clinic") acts as the data controller for the personal data described below.
1. Data Controller: Dr. Nurhan İnan Dental Clinic, Plaza 224, Floor 4, No 24, Nilüfer/Bursa, Turkey.
2. Personal Data Processed: Full name, phone number, email address, and any appointment or message content shared through the contact form.
3. Purposes of Processing: Evaluating appointment requests, maintaining patient communication, responding to treatment and pricing inquiries.
4. Legal Basis: Your explicit consent under KVKK Art. 5/2, and/or necessity for the establishment or performance of a contract.
5. Data Sharing: Your personal data is not shared with third parties except where legally required.
6. Your Rights: Under KVKK Art. 11, you have the right to learn whether your data is processed, and to request correction or deletion. You may submit requests to info@drnurhaninan.com.
Kvkk.metaDescription: Dr. Nurhan İnan Dental Clinic's KVKK privacy notice and information on the protection of personal data.
